description: Implementation of scheduler_event_logger class for logging various scheduler events in a 5G NR system, including PRACH, RACH, UE creation/reconfiguration/removal, error indications, SRS, CSI reports, BSR, HARQ ACK, CRC, MAC CE, RLC buffer state, PHR, and slice reconfiguration.

classes.name: scheduler_event_logger
classes.description: Logger class for recording various scheduler events in a 5G NR system.

methods.name: scheduler_event_logger
methods.description: Constructor initializing logger with cell index and PCI, setting log mode based on logger configuration.

methods.name: log_impl
methods.description: Logs processed slot events, either in debug or info mode.

methods.name: enqueue_impl
methods.description: Overloaded methods to enqueue different types of scheduler events for logging, including PRACH, RACH, UE events, errors, SRS, CSI, BSR, HARQ ACK, CRC, MAC CE, RLC buffer state, PHR, and slice reconfiguration.

methods.name: separator
methods.description: Returns separator string based on whether the buffer has content.
